evals.prompt: Ho appena fixato un bug nel token tracking. L'input_tokens includeva i cached tokens causando la stamina bar a mostrare 100%. Salva questa scoperta nel brain.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file in documentation/bugs/ with proper YAML frontmatter (type: bug_fix, project, created, last_verified, tags), descriptive kebab-case filename, structured sections (Problem, Solution, Key Insight), and all 4 save criteria met.

assertions.name: has_yaml_frontmatter
assertions.description: Output file has valid YAML frontmatter with type, project, created, last_verified, tags fields

assertions.name: correct_type_field
assertions.description: Frontmatter type is bug_fix or bug

assertions.name: kebab_case_filename
assertions.description: Filename uses descriptive kebab-case (not generic like bug-fix-1.md)

assertions.name: has_structured_sections
assertions.description: Contains Problem, Solution, and Key Insight sections

assertions.name: correct_location
assertions.description: File is saved in documentation/bugs/ directory

evals.prompt: Devo modificare il sistema di automazioni. Prima di iniziare, cerca nel brain cosa sappiamo gia sulle automazioni.
evals.expected_output: Agent searches CLAUDE.md Knowledge Base for automation references, reads relevant entries from documentation/ (gotchas, patterns, decisions), and presents a summary of existing knowledge about automations.

assertions.name: checks_claude_md_first
assertions.description: Agent reads CLAUDE.md or references its Knowledge Base section as the first step

assertions.name: finds_automation_entries
assertions.description: Agent finds and reads at least 2 automation-related entries (gotchas, patterns, etc.)

assertions.name: follows_access_chain
assertions.description: Agent follows the access chain order: CLAUDE.md -> documentation/ -> ~/.quack/brain/

assertions.name: presents_summary
assertions.description: Agent presents a structured summary of automation knowledge found

evals.prompt: Ho implementato un nuovo pattern per la gestione dei WebSocket nel modulo remote. Scrivi il diary entry e crea un diagramma mermaid del flusso dati WebSocket -> Rust handler -> React state.
evals.expected_output: Two files: 1) A diary entry in documentation/diary/ with correct format (YAML frontmatter with type:diary, date, bullet with real timestamp and user name from CLAUDE.md), 2) A .mmd file with valid Mermaid syntax showing the WebSocket data flow.

assertions.name: diary_has_frontmatter
assertions.description: Diary file has YAML frontmatter with type: diary, project, and date fields

assertions.name: diary_uses_real_timestamp
assertions.description: Diary bullet uses actual time from date command, not invented time

assertions.name: diary_correct_author
assertions.description: Author in diary bullet is 'Alek' (from CLAUDE.md), not the agent name

assertions.name: mermaid_valid_syntax
assertions.description: The .mmd file contains valid Mermaid diagram syntax (graph/flowchart/sequence)

assertions.name: mermaid_covers_flow
assertions.description: Diagram shows WebSocket -> Rust handler -> React state flow
